messages.auth2FARequired: You need to set up two-factor authentication. Choose the method in the next window: an authenticator app on your phone (for example, Google Authenticator) or a security key (YubiKey), if the administrator allows it.
messages.phoneExtensionTaken: Another active user has this extension.

tooltips.cPhoneExtension: The desk phone extension in the PBX (Vtiger phone_crm_extension). Only administrators change it: calls are assigned and call cards shown by it, calls from the CRM ring it. Active users never share an extension.
